mapper.insert: insert into agent_message (message_id, session_id, task_id, role, content, content_type, token_count, seq_no, create_time) values (#{messageId}, #{sessionId}, #{taskId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{contentType}, #{tokenCount}, #{seqNo}, #{createTime})

insert ignore into agent_message (message_id, session_id, task_id, role, content, content_type, token_count, seq_no, create_time) values (#{messageId}, #{sessionId}, #{taskId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{contentType}, #{tokenCount}, #{seqNo}, now())
